title: cycladenia humilis var. tomentosa
intro: Cycladenia humilis var. tomentosa, commonly known as the 'hairy desert marigold', is a perennial plant that belongs to the Apocynaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its multiple health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents of Cycladenia humilis var. tomentosa include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
